name: build-correction-durable
description: Case A durability. The same defect report as build-defect-reopen, checked for what survives it: a reopen writes only a status cell, so once the row reads `done` again the ledger is byte-identical to a phase in which the defect never happened. Build must record the human's exact words as an `R…` event with `source: build` before reopening anything, and resolve it in the run that fixes it — the same durable route a review finding takes.
prompt: mano-build "requiring src/release-stage.js returns base+release, not base+feature+release"
